name: TCL 75" Class QM8 Series 4K Mini-LED QLED Smart Google TV
description: Transform your living room into an absolute cinematic theater paradise! This stunning TCL 75-Inch flagship QM8 Series (75QM850G) is a premium powerhouse built on high-end QD-Mini LED QLED panel technology. Packing up to 2,300 independent local dimming zones and an incredibly blinding 2,000+ nits peak brightness, it serves up inky, OLED-grade deep blacks and crisp contrast with absolutely zero blooming. An absolute dream setup for next-gen PS5/Xbox gamers and sports fans, boasting a native 144Hz refresh rate (up to 240Hz at 1080p), FreeSync Premium Pro, and ultra-low input lag. Features an intuitive Google TV OS with hands-free voice controls and a premium built-in subwoofer sound system on the back for thunderous bass. Crystal clear, pristine screen, and runs flawlessly!
contact_note: The TV is in pristine physical and working condition, mounted safely on its original center pedestal stand. Includes the original backlit voice remote and universal power cable. Please bring a spacious truck, a large cargo van, or an SUV wide enough to carry a massive 75-inch screen panel flat, along with a friend to help lift and load it!
meta_description: Pre-owned flagship 75" TCL QM8 Series 4K QD-Mini LED QLED Smart TV (Model 75QM850G) in good condition. Features 2300 dimming zones, native 144Hz refresh rate, Google TV OS, and built-in subwoofer.
name_zh: 雷鸟/智显 TCL 75英寸 QM8系列 旗舰级 4K Mini-LED 144Hz 巨幕智能电视
description_zh: 客厅娱乐与家庭影院的画质天花板！这款 TCL 75英寸旗舰级 QM850G (QM8) 巨幕电视，采用顶尖的 QD-Mini LED 量子点背光技术，拥有高达 2,300 个独立分区控光与 2,000+ 尼特超高峰值亮度，能呈现媲美 OLED 级别的纯黑与惊人对比度。原生 144Hz 极速电竞级高刷、具备 FreeSync Premium Pro 认证，配合低延迟模式（ALLM），是 PS5/Xbox 游戏党、动作大片和体育迷的终极神器。内置高级 Google TV 智能系统及 Hands-free 远场语音助手。最震撼的是机身背面自带大功率超重低音炮（Subwoofer），音质浑厚立体。屏幕完好无划痕，显示极度完美。
